scope.title: Scope
scope.default: Authenticated actor-owned inventory only; no public internet scan

limitations.title: Limitations
default: Static discovery only; this module never executes PoC code or scans a target.
NO_EVIDENCE is bounded absence in stored records, not proof no exploit exists.
Association confirmation alone cannot establish exploit usability.
Missing title details/language/verification time remain unknown; links are not fetched by this GET.

scheduler_semantics.title: Scheduler Semantics
scheduler_semantics.default: Worker is operator opt-in; these GETs never trigger collection, models or risk computation.

availability_semantics.title: Availability Semantics
availability_semantics.default: AVAILABLE is queryability, not a blanket verification or exploit verdict.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.default: Declared bounded sources; not global completeness or grade attainment
